messages:
alex: Heads-up — customer reported that audit CSV export for their org dropped columns and returned 403 intermittently when using Audit Viewer role. They can view in UI but export fails. attaching sample headers they got.

maria: @alex can you paste the exact error body or screenshots? 403 could be RBAC check or KMS deny on the export job.

alex: Screenshot shows 403 with message 'export.request.denied'. UI view works. Export log shows: `export_job_id=ej-9f8a`, `user_id=U1234`, `org_id=org-88`. Also sample CSV header from customer:

```
# timestamp,event_type,user,resource,ip
2026-03-19 12:02:01,model.generate,alice,deploy/rdw-1,10.1.2.3
```

csv missing `actor_role` and `kms_key_id` which we recently added.

sam: I ran a quick check — export path goes through the export-service which calls kms to sign pre-signed url for S3. If KMS denies due to CMK policy it returns 403. But they said other orgs export fine. Could be a conditional on org tag.

irene: @sam add RBAC angle: we rolled out a tiny change last week that split Audit Viewer vs Audit Exporter permissions (wen't enforced exporter role earlier). Some customers have only Viewer. The UI export button should have been gated but might still call the endpoint. That could explain 403.

alex: Repro steps I ran locally:
1) log in as user with Audit Viewer role only.
2) open console -> Audit Logs -> click Export -> get 403 in network tab.
3) exchange logs show `403 ExportNotAllowed: missing export_permission`.

maria: Good repro. Two problems then: gating in UI and customer-facing CSV schema mismatch (we added fields but older exports and examples omit them). Need to decide on backfill vs optional fields.

sam: For pagination we use limit+offset. Large orgs can hit 10k rows and we chunk into pages server-side and stream to CSV. If a page fails due to KMS or permission we should either fail whole job or include partial with error footer. Which do we want?

irene: Security preference: fail the job and log explicit audit_event for failed export attempt. Otherwise partial exports could leak inconsistent state. Also include an error code in the job record.

alex: Customer wants CSV exported even if some rows lack `kms_key_id` (null) but not to silently drop columns. They also complained exported file truncated at ~65k rows.

maria: 65k truncation sounds like integer overflow in our CSV streamer buffer or S3 multipart threshold bug. I recall a fix was merged in eng-runtime but not rolled to stage. @devops-bot when was the multipart fix deployed?

devops-bot: deploy-bot: release/eng-runtime v1.12.2 deployed to production on 2026-03-10 03:21 UTC by @ci.

maria: Hmm we have that release but the export-service sidecars might be on older tag in that cluster. I'll check.

sam: Schema change note: we renamed `event_type` -> `audit_action` in the schema migration last month. The exporter still supports both but CSV header is controlled by serializer config. If customer saw `event_type` we must support it as alias. Make export tolerant: include both columns if present? Document choice.

irene: Also KMS integration: export jobs use a customer CMK to encrypt archive. If the CMK has restriction by condition that denies `kms:GenerateDataKey*` for export-service principal, that will 403. Need clearer customer-facing error that says 'KMS key policy denies export' not generic 403.

alex: Proposed short-term fixes: 1) UI block export button if user lacks Exporter permission (prevent silent 403). 2) Make exporter return structured error JSON with reason 'rbac'/'kms' and error_code for customers. 3) Make CSV serializer include columns added recently but allow nulls rather than drop. 4) Failing export on any page for consistency.

maria: Agreed. I'll make a small UX patch to disable button + tooltip pointing to docs. @sam can you own server-side structured error and add audit_event for failed export?

sam: Yep. I'll add error codes: EXPORT_FORBIDDEN_RBAC, EXPORT_KMS_DENY, EXPORT_INTERNAL_CHUNK_FAIL. Will also add job.status=failed and retention of partial artifact for debugging but not public deliverable.

irene: I'll draft customer-facing docs wording for KMS errors and required key policy snippet. Also check if any existing incidents exposed CMKs.

alex: For the schema/validation piece: should we run a validation pass on all historical audit events to ensure they conform to new schema and backfill `actor_role` where possible? That could be heavy.

maria: Backfill heavy. Instead mark new fields optional and update docs and API to return `null` when unknown. Do a selective backfill for enterprise customers on request.

sam: Implementation tasks:
- export-service: return structured error + job status change + single-point schema serializer config (1d)
- console: disable export button when missing exporter role + add tooltip + small event for telemetry (0.5d)
- security: docs + KMS policy sample (0.5d)
- ops: ensure sidecar image updated in cluster (0.25d)

irene: Also file a vuln-triage ticket: CVE? not needed but record security impact (data availability vs confidentiality). I'll link evidence.

alex: Temporary mitigation: email the affected customer that export requires Exporter role and provide steps to grant or request support to run export manually.

maria: I'll push a hotfix to console by EOD to hide the button. Sam please cut the server patch PR tomorrow morning.

sam: Will do. I'll add unit tests that simulate KMS Deny and RBAC deny to ensure structured error.

alex: Thanks all. I'll follow up with the customer once UI patch is deployed.

maria: Filing internal ticket: SEC-EXPORT-2026-03-A. Linking follow-ups and postmortem if we need one. :white_check_mark:
